detected_defects.detail: neither .orchestrator-handoff.json nor .return-meta.json was refreshed within the dispatch window; .return-meta.json still carried the prior planner cycle status=planned. Per docs/architecture/handoff-schema.md the handoff is hard-mode-implement-only, so the genuine defect is the stale .return-meta.json — the documented base-mode outcome channel — which left substantial committed work unreportable and unrecoverable by orchestrate-recover-outcome.sh (reason=META_STALE).
